ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 96:4 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white/light pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous mass covering >90% of the fluke; high-contrast white clusters localized at both distal tips; sparse, isolated white circular spots scattered across the surface; light-gray vertical shading near the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 75 degrees and a central depth of approximately 12% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations are more pronounced on the right lobe with higher peak frequency toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a standard convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters detected at both distal tips; multiple isolated circular white points (rosettes) approximately 3-5 pixels in diameter scattered on the lower central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization or calcified scarring at both the left and right distal fluke tips.
